name: Chess Player
description: Evaluates an agent's ability to play competitive chess against itself or an engine using Standard Algebraic Notation.

binding_vow.description: A self-play or engine-based chess task where the agent must select high-quality legal moves. Success is determined by maximizing positional advantage (centipawn delta) and ultimately winning games.

action_space.description: Reason and state the desired chess move in Standard Algebraic Notation (SAN), e.g., 'e4', 'Nf3', 'O-O'. A list of all legal moves has been provided in legal_moves, and you MUST pick a move from the list of legal moves provided. Additionally, you MUST avoid picking moves from the must_avoid_moves list.

reward.description: Based on the centipawn evaluation delta from Stockfish following the move, plus bonuses/penalties for game outcomes or illegal actions.
